name: argon2id-wasm
description: Argon2id password hashing and verification for browsers via WebAssembly.

scripts.build:wasm:web: cargo build --manifest-path wasm-source/argon2id/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen wasm-source/argon2id/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm_argon2id.wasm --out-dir src/wasm --target web
scripts.build:wasm:cloudflare: cargo build --manifest-path wasm-source/argon2id/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen wasm-source/argon2id/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm_argon2id.wasm --out-dir src/wasm --target bundler
